L&T Metro Rail publishes monthly ridership at this URL and a reported Apr2024-Mar2025 sum reproduces the recorded 161,965,658. Not independently re-confirmed here, and the page states no counting convention; 'passenger_journeys' is inferred from operator AFC practice, not from a definition. Separately: the figure is FY2024-25 (Apr-Mar) while annual_year records 2025.

KMRL publishes monthly ridership here. Checked 2026-09-20: the table carried only Jan-Apr 2025 (sum 11,157,056), so the recorded 36,412,974 for calendar 2025 could NOT be confirmed. The page labels the column 'Ridership' and defines no convention; journeys and boardings coincide anyway on a single-line network.

Fukuoka City Subway publishes 輸送人員 as a daily average. The recorded 191,340,665 reproduces as FY2024 daily average 524,221 x 365, i.e. it is derived from a daily figure rather than a reported annual total. FY2024 = Apr 2024-Mar 2025, while annual_year records 2024.

Korean 수송인원 is defined 승차기준 (boarding basis), 유입인원 excluded, so the convention is boardings-like; but the per-operator table is JavaScript-loaded and the recorded 141,985,000 was not confirmed against it. Left as 'estimated' because the value is a derivation from a daily average.

Recorded 31,600,000 matches no located source. Maha Metro's 2024-25 annual report gives approximately 26.9 million; a widely-copied 40.15M is itself extrapolated from a 110,000/day figure. Convention undetermined.

Official ICTR series (data.go.kr dataset 15051190) gives 2025 수송인원 232,640,801 / 승차인원 154,876,634 / 유입인원 77,764,167. No year-and-column combination in the 1999-2025 file equals the recorded 170,486,755.
Recorded 46,000,000 is a rounding: Taoyuan Metro's monthly 旅運量 for 2025 sum to roughly 46.6 million. The 旅運量 convention itself is not established.
